subject: Data handling & model improvement opt-out — operational checklist and subprocessor whitelist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: procurement@medsyn.example.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data handling & model improvement opt-out — operational checklist and subprocessor whitelist

Hi team,

Thanks for the time on the demo last week. Following up with a concise list of operational commitments Medsyn requested around the DPA and model-improvement opt-out. We want to make the procurement review as straightforward as possible, so Im proposing the items below for the DPA/operational addendum. Please confirm which of these are mandatory from your side vs. "nice to have."

Requested commitments (summary):
- Formal no-training/no-derivatives clause (no records used for model updates outside your tenant)
- EU residency for stored interaction data and backups (AWS eu-west-1 or equivalent)
- Subprocessor whitelist (we will provide a list + exception workflow for future subprocessors)
- Key management: customer-managed KMS option or onshore key escrow for EU accounts
- Telemetry/analytics: strictly aggregated/system health metrics acceptable; no raw prompt persistence for model training
- Evidence: SOC 2 report, penetration test summary, and operational runbook outlining deletion flows

If helpful, we can provide a short operational checklist (exported as an attachment) and a redline DPA for your legal team to review. Can you confirm:+
- Primary contact for legal?
- Any procurement-specific clauses (PO terms, signature authority, SLA thresholds) we should pre-seed in the redline?

Ill loop in our security and legal leads for any follow-up. Want to propose a 30-min call next Tue (Apr 20) to walk the checklist and align on sign-off dates.

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
Attachments: none in this message

From: procurement@medsyn.example.com <procurement@medsyn.example.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medsyn.example.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Data handling & model improvement opt-out — operational checklist and subprocessor whitelist

Alex --

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifying points from our side before we commit to the call:

1) When you say "no-training/no-derivatives," we need an explicit definition in the DPA of whats excluded (e.g., fine-tuning, batch re-training, model distillation).
2) Subprocessor whitelist: please share your current list and the process/lead time for adding a required subprocessor. We have an internal policy that requires 30 days notice+approval for any new subprocessor touching EU data.
3) We require customer-managed encryption keys or an onshore-managed key option for EU accounts; confirm whether Redwood supports this for Dedicated or Private deployment modes.

Attached our standard vendor security questionnaire for you to complete (we expect SOC2 + pen test summary). Also flagging that our legal team needs to see a track-changed DPA (DocuSign preferred).

Primary contacts:
- Procurement: Lina Kor (procurement@medsyn.example.com)
- Legal: Marco Silva (legal@medsyn.example.com)

Please send the completed questionnaire and a draft redline by EOD Mon (Apr 19) if possible so our legal can do a first pass before the call.

Regards,
Lina Kor
Procurement Manager, Medsyn Health
Attachments: medsyn-vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data handling & model improvement opt-out — operational checklist and subprocessor whitelist

Alex / David,

Quick internal note before we send anything to Medsyn: we should offer a clear, implementable operational promise rather than open-ended language. My suggested approach:

- Legal DPA clause: "Customer Data will not be used to improve any global model weights or to create derivative models outside the customer's dedicated tenant or agreed, isolated variants." Explicitly list whats allowed (system health metrics, aggregated usage counters) and whats prohibited (raw prompt retention beyond retention window for debugging).
- Retention: set a default ephemeral prompt retention of 30 days for EU customers with an opt-in toggle for shorter retention at provisioning time.
- Subprocessors: provide current whitelist (S3 eu-west-1, RDS eu-west-1, Redwood Analytics EU cluster) and a written 30-day notification + approval window for new subprocessors (we will not add a new EU data subprocessors without prior notice).
- KMS: customer-managed keys available for Dedicated and Private; Hosted customers can request onshore key escrow for EU accounts for an additional governance fee.

We can prepare: (1) a DPA redline with those bullets translated into contract text, and (2) an operational checklist (one-pager) that procurement can walk through with Lina. Once David confirms the KMS wording, Ill sign off on the redline.

Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: procurement@medsyn.example.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data handling & model improvement opt-out — operational checklist and subprocessor whitelist

Hi Lina / Marco,

Thanks for the quick reply. Per Lina's ask, attached are: (1) a track-changed DPA redline (DPA-redline-v1.pdf) implementing the no-training/derivatives language described below, and (2) an operational checklist (operational-checklist.xlsx) that maps commitments to operational owners and timelines. Highlights in the redline:
- "No model training or derivative creation involving Customer Data outside of Customers dedicated tenant, including fine-tuning or dataset aggregation for model updates."
- EU residency requirement: data at rest and backups reside in AWS eu-west-1; cross-border transfers only with explicit customer consent and documented SCCs/transfer mechanism.
- Subprocessor whitelist: enumerated list + 30-day notification/approval process for additions.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated/Private; hosted EU customers can opt for onshore-managed key escrow.

We also completed the vendor security questionnaire and attached a pen-test executive summary in a separate secure link (we can provide the full report under NDA).

Proposed next steps:
1) Your legal does an initial pass on the redline (DocuSign link below for convenience).
2) 30-min alignment call tomorrow Wed Apr 21 10:00 CET (please confirm).
3) If legal signs off, we proceed to DocuSign routing.

DocuSign (redline): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abc123-dpa
Confluence runbook (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INFR-5272

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA-redline-v1.pdf, operational-checklist.xlsx

From: Marco Silva <legal@medsyn.example.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Data handling & model improvement opt-out — operational checklist and subprocessor whitelist

Alex / Kimberly / David,

Thanks for the redline and checklist. Quick summary from our review team: the no-training language and the subprocessor notification window are acceptable pending two small edits (we will mark them in the DocuSign redline):

1) Require a 7-business-day remediation notice to Medsyn before Redwood applies any changes to the subprocessor list that would impact onshore processing flows.
2) Add a short clause that any aggregated telemetry used for product improvement will exclude raw prompts and unique identifiers; please add the specific telemetry fields that may be retained (error rates, token counts, latency).

We can confirm the call for Wed Apr 21 10:00 CET and expect to route the final DPA for signature after we resolve the two edits above.

Lina (procurement) will handle DocuSign routing on our side; Ill follow up with the signed copy.

Regards,
Marco Silva
Senior Counsel, Medsyn Health
Attachments: none
